provenance: BIE's own drawings (families/econ_finance.mjs), built 5 November 2026 for the finance and macro needs of the Sloman Economics chapter workers (58 needs, 488 beats); no logos, real landmarks or real persons; words only through parameters

circularFlow.what: the circular flow: households and firms with an outer money loop and an inner real loop (goods, labour) running opposite ways, goods market on top and factor market below (mode goods), or the money ring with withdrawals S, T, M leaving for their sectors and injections I, G, X joining the firms, each as thick as its amount, W and J totals, income counting up (mode income); an enclosing environment ring with resources in and wastes out

top.what: goods: the market named on top

arrows.what: goods: money top;real top;money bottom;real bottom labels (spending;goods;wages;labour); income: top;bottom (Cd;Y)

realToken.what: what the inner bottom loop carries

size.what: thickness of the whole flow (expansion, contraction)

sectors.what: income: the sector boxes, e.g. बैंक;सरकार;विदेश

lit.what: income: names of the lit branches, e.g. S,I (empty: all)

income.what: income: the ring amount Y (top shows Y − W)

incomeFrom.what: income: Y counts from this to income after the step

brackets.what: income: W and J totals (green when equal)

unit.what: unit: ₹, $, % or a word (₹ करोड़ puts ₹ before and करोड़ after)

glide.what: seconds the change after a step takes

inputs.what: arrow from the ring into firms

outputs.what: arrow from households to the ring

chainRounds.what: a round-by-round chain process the drawing computes: one amount travels through stops (banks, shops, people); at each a share is kept (reserves) and a share leaks (cash held, saving), the rest moves on; round n lights on its step (the note travels, slices drop, the total bar adds its block) and the total climbs to its limit start/(keep+leak); view bars draws the rounds as shrinking bars (multiplier tower)

leak.what: share leaving the chain at each stop

upto.what: rounds lit so far (0: all); the newest plays over glide

final.what: jump the total to its limit

passLabel.what: bars: legend for the share passed on

limit.what: write the limit above the bar

unit.what: unit: ₹, $, % or a word (₹ करोड़ puts ₹ before and करोड़ after)

glide.what: seconds the change after a step takes

tank.what: a stock-flow tank: water level is the stock, taps pour flows in and spouts let flows out, each as wide as its rate; the level glides from where it was to where it goes after the step, or settles like a leaky tank whose outflow grows with the level (W = J); level marks, a stand plate, a stopped or running clock (stock vs flow)

from.what: where it was at the step (-1: no motion)

settle.what: approach the level like a leaky tank (outflow grows with the level)

grows.what: spout jets grow with the level

ins.what: taps in: label:rate;… rate 0..1 (up to 3), e.g. निवेश (J):0.6

glide.what: seconds the change after a step takes

balanceSheet.what: a two-sided balance sheet (T-account): assets left, liabilities and capital right, rows entering on cue, a value gliding from its old amount, totals that balance (tick) or not (cross), the capital row a cushion; view blocks stacks both sides by size and a loss eats the top asset and the capital cushion (insolvent when it is gone)

upto.what: rows shown on each side (0: all)

capital.what: which liabilities row is the capital cushion (0: the last)

loss.what: blocks: a loss eating assets and capital

brokeLabel.what: blocks: shown when capital is gone

unit.what: unit: ₹, $, % or a word (₹ करोड़ puts ₹ before and करोड़ after)

glide.what: seconds the change after a step takes

timeValue.what: value through time: amounts on a time axis (years, months or hours of a day) travel to now shrinking by the discount factor each period and by the present-bias factor if not immediate (dir back), or grow to the last year by (1+r) (dir forward); they stack and sum at the end beside a cost judged by a tick or cross; several rates draw one lane each; now can move

slots.what: names of the slots from now: आज;1 साल;2 साल

rate.what: rate per period, or several rates ;-separated (one lane each)

d.what: discount factor per period instead of rate

b.what: present-bias factor on anything later than now

travel.what: amounts that have travelled; the newest moves over glide

laneLabels.what: names of the lanes (default: the rates)

unit.what: unit: ₹, $, % or a word (₹ करोड़ puts ₹ before and करोड़ after)

glide.what: seconds the change after a step takes

gambleTree.what: a gamble tree: branches from a chance point, each with its probability and outcome; p × outcome terms at the ends that fly into one expected-value pill on the step; a sure path beside it; a step that changes a probability recomputes the terms

fly.what: terms slide into the EV pill over glide after the step

unit.what: unit: ₹, $, % or a word (₹ करोड़ puts ₹ before and करोड़ after)

glide.what: seconds the change after a step takes

insurancePool.what: an insurance pool: many members pay a premium into one pot (coins fly in on phase premium), each year a share of them has an accident and is paid a claim (notes fly out on phase claim); two risk groups, one of which can walk out (adverse selection); a ledger computes premiums in, claims out, admin and the margin

types.what: two groups label:share;label:share (e.g. कम जोखिम:0.01;ज़्यादा जोखिम:0.09)

leave.what: the group that walks out (0: none)

countLabel.what: writes how many were hit out of how many

unit.what: unit: ₹, $, % or a word (₹ करोड़ puts ₹ before and करोड़ after)

glide.what: seconds the change after a step takes

queueLine.what: a queue served while stock lasts: people (or trucks) before a counter, gate, ticket window, operation theatre or bank counter; the counter serves rate per second from the step, the stock falls, at stock 0 a bar drops and the rest turn away or join a waiting list; urgent ones jump ahead, more join at the back, a bank counter's vault drains (a run on the bank)

rate.what: served per second after the step

urgent.what: line places that jump ahead, e.g. 3,7

cut.what: the bar that drops at stock 0

unit.what: unit: ₹, $, % or a word (₹ करोड़ puts ₹ before and करोड़ after)

vaultFull.what: bank: stock that fills the vault (0: the starting stock)

contagion.what: contagion between institutions: banks, domino tiles or named discs in a row or ring joined by lending links with money moving; fail gives the order of the falls, upto = n makes the n-th fall over glide (cracks and tilts, tips onto the next); links of a fallen one freeze; a firewall or capital buffer stops it (shakes and stands); a rescuer's lifeline holds the rescued

stop.what: ones that hold (a wall or buffer)

glide.what: seconds the change after a step takes

securitisation.what: a securitisation chain: loans travel from the lender into a pool owned by an SPV, the pool is cut into tranches (CDOs) that go to the noteholders, cash comes back (stage 0..4, each playing over glide); defaults turn loans red, losses fill the tranches from equity up and the holders of a hit tranche turn red; a RISK tag travels with the loans

stage.what: 0 loans at the lender, 1 into the pool, 2 cut into tranches, 3 to the holders, 4 cash back

glide.what: seconds the change after a step takes

layers.what: a layer stack on a % axis (Basel III capital: Tier 2, AT1, CET1, buffers) built one layer per step with cumulative marks and a buffer that fills or empties (mode stack), or a liquidity ladder from cash (top) to the least liquid asset with growing return tags and a cut line (mode ladder)
label:value;… stack: bottom first; ladder: top first (value = return)

glide.what: seconds the change after a step takes

pricePath.what: a price over time drawn by the graph saancha: given points or a seeded random walk with a drift, a bubble and a burst; it draws itself at the voice's speed, shades above and below a reference price (futures, short selling), shades the bubble gap over a fundamental value line, marks events and rides a dot with its live value

bubble.what: walk: steps of the boom, e.g. 15,30

fromStep.what: draw from the last step instead of the start

upto.what: draw only up to this x

rateCorridor.what: the interest-rate corridor drawn by the graph saancha: ceiling (lending facility), policy rate and floor (deposit facility) over time, the band shaded, the overnight market rate as a dot wandering inside and drawing its trail; floor mode fades the ceiling, a given path can break out of the band, omo pushes the dot back

omo.what: push the dot back to the policy rate

moneySplit.what: one amount that splits into labelled parts, each as big as its amount, and each part flies on its own step to its destination (GST to the tax office, imports to the port, the rest to a factory)

unit.what: unit: ₹, $, % or a word (₹ करोड़ puts ₹ before and करोड़ after)

glide.what: seconds the change after a step takes

tradeLedger.what: a two-way trade between two parties with running ledgers: things (permits, goods) cross one way and money the other on the deal word; each party's ledger values glide and the totals update; a cap pile of permits can shrink

unit.what: unit: ₹, $, % or a word (₹ करोड़ puts ₹ before and करोड़ after)

glide.what: seconds the change after a step takes

road.what: a city road seen from above: lanes each way with cars streaming at a density and slowing to a jam, a bus lane, a car-pool lane, a charging gantry with its display, side streets taking diverted cars, kerb parking (free, banned, paid), roadside houses with fumes, or a closed street of walkers

agents.what: a crowd of agents: identical ones that slide together into one representative agent and split back into different people (mode merge), thought bubbles of a belief spreading across a share of them (mode belief: expectations), or people herding to a stall whose price rises with the crowd (mode herd)

from.what: merge or share at the step (-1: none)

react.what: split people react up or down

spread.what: seconds for the share to grow

glide.what: seconds the change after a step takes

riskDial.what: risk against uncertainty: a coin that flips and lands heads or tails, a spinner whose wedge shows a known chance and whose pointer spins and stops, and a dial lost in fog with a question mark

kind.what: coin, spinner, fog in any order (up to 3)

win.what: the spinner stops in the wedge

accountBar.what: an account balance bar with zero marked: green above zero, a red overdraft zone below it down to the limit; the balance glides from its old value and falls through zero into red on the word

glide.what: seconds the change after a step takes

appliance.what: an appliance of the stories: a pedestal fan that turns when on, a fridge whose door opens, a water tanker with its fill, a TV or a washing machine, with an optional price tag

usedCar.what: a vehicle (small car, sedan, SUV, luxury car, bus, truck) with a damage state (dents, cracked window, smoke), a lemon sticker, wheels that turn and speed lines when moving, and a price tag

certificate.what: a paper of the insurance and information stories: a policy with its rows (cover, premium, excess), a form whose ticks fill in, a degree with its seal or a medical certificate, on which a stamp lands after the step

stamp.what: lands over 0.5 s after the step
